lines.zh: 巡墙一圈，靴子都磨薄了。
lines.en: One round of the wall and my boots wear thinner.

lines.zh: 脚步轻些，别惊动塔上的弓手。
lines.en: Step light, don't startle the archers up top.

lines.zh: 沿着营地木栅走，别踩烂泥。
lines.en: Walking the palisade, mind the mud.

lines.zh: 长枪拖地，倒比举着省力。
lines.en: Dragging my spear beats holding it up.

lines.zh: 从东门到西门，一天八趟。
lines.en: East gate to west gate, eight trips a day.

lines.zh: 铠甲响得像铁匠铺的风箱。
lines.en: My armor creaks like a smithy bellows.

lines.zh: 巡逻路上顺手捡块干柴。
lines.en: Snatching dry wood along the patrol.
Keep the line, don't bunch up.

lines.zh: 换岗前再绕粮仓走一段。
lines.en: One more lap past the granary before the change.

lines.zh: 草地上有脚印，凑近看看。
lines.en: Tracks in the grass — let me look closer.

lines.zh: 皮靴踩过碎石，声音太响。
lines.en: My boots crunch on gravel, far too loud.
I hold the blue banner's side.
Slow down, I'm sweating inside the plate.
Reaching the post means standing still.
The whetstone went unused today.
Wind pours through the crenel, so cold.

lines.zh: 数一数对面的火把有几支。
lines.en: Counting the torches across the way.

lines.zh: 这把短剑是营里发的旧货。
lines.en: This short sword is old camp stock.

lines.zh: 远处的乌鸦落在旗杆上。
lines.en: A crow lands on the far flagpole.
I just want a nap against the wall.

lines.zh: 打完这场就换双新靴子。
lines.en: After this fight, new boots.

lines.zh: 有人在那边磨锤子，叮叮响。
lines.en: Someone's hammering over there, ding ding.
The helm makes my ears itch.

lines.zh: 蓝布罩袍洗了三次还掉色。
lines.en: My blue surcoat still bleeds dye after three washes.

lines.zh: 哨塔的影子慢慢移过来。
lines.en: The watchtower's shadow creeps over me.
Don't yawn, the captain's watching.
I hold this gate under the blue banner.
Joining up, or asking directions?
Keep your hand off that hilt, friend.

lines.zh: 蓝营的地界，往前一步试试。
lines.en: Blue camp's ground — try one step.
You look like you're here to scout.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有泥，从哪来的？
lines.en: Mud on your boots — where from?
Don't stand right under the crenel.
Want through? Talk to the captain first.

lines.zh: 我们这儿不欢迎陌生人乱走。
lines.en: We don't like strangers wandering here.
What are you staring at?

lines.zh: 拿剑的手别抖，我看得见。
lines.en: Steady that sword hand, I can see it.

lines.zh: 报出你的旗号，我就放行。
lines.en: Name your banner and I'll let you pass.

lines.zh: 又是个想偷粮的家伙吧。
lines.en: Another one after our grain, I bet.

lines.zh: 站在那儿别动，等我问完话。
lines.en: Stand right there until I'm done asking.

lines.zh: 我和你没仇，别逼我动手。
lines.en: I've no quarrel with you — don't make one.
The plate caught half of it, still hurts.
Where's my sword? Dropped it.
Back off, I can still stand.
Blood soaks into my surcoat.
Steady, it's just a scratch.
I heard something crack.
Give me a hand, my legs are weak.
The banner stands, so do I.
Good hit, but I'm not yielding.
Is that ale I smell?
Fresh bread — who brought it?
That pot's mutton stew, isn't it.
Save me a bite. One bite.
I smell mead.

lines.zh: 干粮啃了三天，换点热的。
lines.en: Three days of rations — I want something hot.
An apple? Which tree?

lines.zh: 分我半块，我就当没看见。
lines.en: Give me half and I saw nothing.

lines.zh: 这香味把我的岗哨都搅乱了。
lines.en: That smell is wrecking my watch.
Don't take it — just leave it and go.
Hey, that's my shield.
Move along, this is my post.

lines.zh: 走路看着点，盔甲可不软。
lines.en: Watch where you walk, armor isn't soft.

lines.zh: 推我做什么？我又不在偷懒。
lines.en: Why push me? I'm not slacking.
You crowd in and the line breaks.
Knocked my teeth together.
Don't shove, there's only one gate.
Steady — push again and I draw.

lines.zh: 脚下泥滑，别怪我没提醒。
lines.en: The mud's slick, don't say I didn't warn you.

lines.zh: 靠这么近做什么，我不卖东西。
lines.en: Why so close? I'm not selling anything.

lines.zh: 军营里哪来的空闲成家。
lines.en: No room for a family in barracks.

lines.zh: 等打完仗，我再想这些事。
lines.en: After the war I'll think about that.

lines.zh: 你找错人了，我只管站岗。
lines.en: Wrong person — I only stand guard.
My bride-price is an old sword.

lines.zh: 队长知道了要罚我扫马厩。
lines.en: The captain would have me muck the stables.

lines.zh: 这种事该在村里办，不在营地。
lines.en: That belongs in a village, not a camp.

lines.zh: 先把盔甲脱了再谈别的。
lines.en: Let me get this armor off first.

lines.zh: 帐篷太薄，什么都挡不住。
lines.en: The tent is thin, it hides nothing.
Wait until the rotation.

lines.zh: 别在这儿，哨塔上有人看着。
lines.en: Not here, the tower's watching.
Whose arrow? Mine now.
This dagger can still be ground.
Picking up crumbs too? Fine.
I was short a whetstone.
A copper coin — extra food tonight.
This scrap can patch my breastplate.
Pocketing a broken spearhead.
Dry cloth — good for the blade.
Who threw out this boot? Still wearable.
Movement — someone's over there.
Shields up, this one means harm.
Where's the horn? Sound it.
That's an enemy banner, not a caravan.
Quick, keep him off the gate.
Target, ten paces to my left.
Someone wake the archers.
I saw steel flash.
Halt — last warning.
He's gone behind the fence.
Don't blink, he's fast.
I close in slow and let him come.
Counting paces — five left.
That weapon of his is heavy.
Don't back up, there's a wall behind.
I watch his feet; feet move first.
Hold, let him swing first.
He's panting, nearly spent.
That's it, stay on him.
Take a swing of my longsword!
Thrust at the ribs, no plate there.
Shield forward, pin him.

lines.zh: 这一下是替粮仓的兄弟。
lines.en: This one's for the granary lads.
Running? Have another cut!
Break his guard.
Don't stop the hand, keep cutting.
My sword's shorter than yours.
Did I land it? Hard to tell.
Switch hands, next strike goes left.
Blue banner's side — my watch now.
Armor on, sword issued, fall in.
Another day on the wall.
Out of the barracks at first light.
New recruit reporting — don't laugh.
Who took my boots?
The fire's still warm and I'm on duty.
Blue camp's reinforcing — count me in.

lines.zh: 铁匠给我磨了刃，正好试试。
lines.en: The smith honed it — good time to test.
Windy here — which side do I take?
Fire! The plate's searing into me.

lines.zh: 从垛口摔下来，腰快断了。
lines.en: Fell off the crenel, my back's done.
Water in my helm, I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 箭钉在胸甲上，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow's stuck in my breastplate.
That spell bites into my bones.

lines.zh: 粮车还没来，我饿得发抖。
lines.en: Supply cart's late, I'm shaking with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈在旗杆上，我耳朵聋了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the pole — I'm deaf.
